ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icon strokes, card and section borders, nav links

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, helper copy, muted borders, image strokes

warm-charcoal.$description: Warm Charcoal — Warm-toned text and borders — the brown-tinted dark used where the system needs a softer, paper-friendly alternative to pure black

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle section backgrounds, button hover fills, nav border, badge surfaces

linen.$description: Linen — Card surface tint, secondary background panels, body section fills

hairline.$description: Hairline — Dividers and borders where a softer separator is needed

pebble.$description: Pebble — Tertiary icon strokes, decorative image borders

sage.$description: Sage — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Primary page canvas and white card surfaces

crimson-pro.$description: Headlines and section titles — a custom serif at whisper weight is the system's signature; most SaaS sites use 600–700 sans for headings, this 300 serif trades volume for editorial elegance

inter.$description: Body copy, UI labels, nav links, button text, captions, card descriptions — the working sans for everything that isn't a headline; weight 500 is reserved for button labels and nav emphasis

georgia.$description: Inline editorial body — appears in article-preview content blocks as a serif voice, reinforcing the manuscript metaphor against the Inter interface chrome
